entries.question: How does device enrollment work?
entries.answer: Install the Windows Agent. In the admin console, choose Pair device, set the access permissions, and generate a one-time code. Enter that code in the Agent, review the organization and permissions, and authorize the device.

board.heading: Enrolling a device
lines: Generate a pairing code in Admin

entries.question: Where is my Meeting ID?
entries.answer: Your Meeting ID and sign-in details arrive in the delivery pack after your payment confirms. Treat the Meeting ID like a credential — it is what authorizes devices into your workspace. If yours is lost or exposed, contact the team so it can be rotated.

entries.question: How many devices can I enroll?
entries.answer: Each plan includes a device allowance — Starter covers 10 devices, Team 20, Business 50, and Enterprise is unlimited. Enrollment enforces seat availability, so a device only joins while a seat is free. You can move between tiers as you grow without changing your workflow.
